claims.claim: The claimant must get a qualifying benefit.
claims.quote: You (or your partner) must get one or more of the following: Universal Credit income-related Employment and Support Allowance Pension Credit Housing Benefit
claims.note: The text lists the benefits the claimant or partner must get.

claims.claim: Proof of the qualifying benefit must be provided as evidence.
claims.note: The text makes getting a benefit a condition but never says proof of it must be sent; you can even claim while still waiting for a benefit decision.

claims.claim: A death certificate is needed as evidence to claim.
claims.note: Death certificates are mentioned only as a cost the payment can help with, not as evidence needed to claim.
